name: resample
description: Live resampling: the Sample Recorder records into the sample bank's free space; Play during a recording, or a recording started with Shift+Rec, plays the pattern with the engine on

branches.note: record start 0x600f9074: bl 0x6010cb90(rec, 0x8026a000, 0x3c00000, ch, ch, flag) -> mt_rs_rec_buffer (the buffer moved above the loaded samples)
record start 0x600f9074: bl 0x6010c890(rec), the record queues' start (from Rec and from the count-in's end) -> mt_rs_rec_started (Shift+Rec: open the gates, play the pattern)

words.note: the recorder's button binder's pool word for the Rec handler 0x600d0621 -> mt_rs_rec_button (Shift held: arm the pattern start)
the recorder start's pool word for the Play button handler 0x600d07b5 -> mt_rs_play_button (opens the gates first during a moved recording)
Sample Recorder vtable, update 0x600fafe9 -> mt_rs_update (closes the gates once the recording has stopped)

ITCM image (copied to ITCM 0x1f544 at boot): the literal of the thunk 0x1f540 that engine_block_update (0x41d8) asks, rec+0x2c 0x6010c889 -> mt_rs_is_recording (no early return while the gates are open)
